Card Q&A.a: Yes, your opponent chooses. If they decide not to trash any security cards, the player who used this card receives the benefits of the  effect.
Card Q&A.q: When using this card, does my opponent get to decide whether or not they trash one of their security cards?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. Your opponent doesn't have a security card to trash, which means you get the  effect automatically.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card if my opponent's security stack is empty?

Effect: [Main] Your opponent may trash the top card of their security stack. If they don't, trigger ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
